cards.example_en: Teachers will inspect our classrooms before the visitors arrive tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 明天来宾到达之前，老师会检查我们的教室。

cards.example_en: Uncle drove his jeep along the muddy road to the village.
cards.example_zh: 叔叔开着吉普车，沿着泥泞的路驶向村子。

cards.example_en: Buy one kilogram of apples on your way home from school today.
cards.example_zh: 今天放学回家的路上，买一千克苹果。

cards.example_en: When we were ill, our kind-hearted neighbour shared her soup.
cards.example_zh: 我们生病时，好心的邻居把汤分给了我们。

cards.example_en: Dad climbed the ladder to fix the loose roof tiles.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸爬上梯子，去修松动的屋瓦。

cards.example_en: Hot soup burned her lip, so she drank some cold water.
cards.example_zh: 热汤烫了她的嘴唇，于是她喝了点凉水。

cards.example_en: Passengers heard a loudspeaker announce the next train at the station.
cards.example_zh: 乘客们听见扬声器在车站播报下一趟火车。

cards.example_en: Every hour a ferry takes visitors from the island to the mainland.
cards.example_zh: 每小时都有一班渡轮把游客从岛上送到大陆。

cards.example_en: She enjoys mathematics and often helps friends with difficult problems.
cards.example_zh: 她喜欢数学，经常帮朋友解答难题。

cards.example_en: Twenty minus eight equals twelve in our math class.
cards.example_zh: 数学课上，二十减去八等于十二。

cards.example_en: We took photos by the monument in the centre of the square.
cards.example_zh: 我们在广场中央的纪念碑旁拍了照。

cards.example_en: My brother rides his motorbike to work when the weather is fine.
cards.example_zh: 天气好的时候，我哥哥骑摩托车去上班。

cards.example_en: Grandma wore a silver necklace to the family dinner on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 星期天家庭聚餐时，奶奶戴了一条银项链。

cards.example_en: Dad chose a blue necktie to wear with his white shirt.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸挑了一条蓝色领带来配他的白衬衫。

cards.example_en: At weekends the night-club on this street stays open very late.
cards.example_zh: 周末，这条街上的夜总会营业到很晚。

cards.example_en: Harbin lies in the northeast of China and has cold winters.
cards.example_zh: 哈尔滨位于中国东北，冬天很冷。

cards.example_en: Today the wind from the northwest made the lake very cold.
cards.example_zh: 今天，从西北吹来的风让湖水变得很冷。

cards.example_en: Oh! I left my keys in the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 哦！我把钥匙落在教室里了。

cards.example_en: We ate lunch outdoors because the classroom was too warm.
cards.example_zh: 教室太热了，所以我们在户外吃了午饭。

cards.example_en: In the pet shop, that parrot can say hello and goodbye.
cards.example_zh: 在宠物店里，那只鹦鹉会说你好和再见。

cards.example_en: A green pea rolled off my plate during lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭时，一颗青豌豆从我的盘子里滚了出去。

cards.example_en: Her red pencil-box holds pens, a ruler, and two erasers.
cards.example_zh: 她的红色铅笔盒里装着钢笔、一把尺子和两块橡皮。

cards.example_en: During our science week, a physicist answered questions about light.
cards.example_zh: 科学周里，一位物理学家回答了关于光的问题。

cards.example_en: During dinner, a young pianist played softly at the hotel.
cards.example_zh: 晚餐时，一位年轻的钢琴家在酒店里轻轻地演奏。

cards.example_en: Dirty plates sit in a pile beside the kitchen sink.
cards.example_zh: 脏盘子在厨房水槽旁堆成一堆。

cards.example_en: For this letter to Shanghai, the postage is only three yuan.
cards.example_zh: 这封寄往上海的信，邮资只要三元。

cards.example_en: I dropped the postcard into the red postbox near our school.
cards.example_zh: 我把明信片投进了学校附近的红色邮筒。

cards.example_en: Write the postcode clearly so the parcel reaches the right street.
cards.example_zh: 把邮政编码写清楚，包裹才能送到正确的街道。

cards.example_en: It is probable that the match will move indoors if it rains.
cards.example_zh: 如果下雨，比赛很可能会改到室内进行。

cards.example_en: Pull the quilt up if you feel cold during the night.
cards.example_zh: 夜里觉得冷的话，就把被子拉上来。

cards.example_en: A loose rail made the train stop outside town.
cards.example_zh: 一根松动的铁轨让火车停在了城外。

cards.example_en: A new regulation keeps bikes outside the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 一条新规则要求自行车停在校门外。

cards.example_en: Two men tried to rob the small shop late on Saturday night.
cards.example_zh: 周六深夜，两名男子企图抢劫那家小店。

cards.example_en: At the back of the shop, the salesgirl showed me a cheaper bag.
cards.example_zh: 在商店后面，女售货员给我看了一个更便宜的包。

cards.example_en: When my pen ran out of ink, a schoolmate lent me another.
cards.example_zh: 我的笔没墨水时，一位同学借给了我另一支。

cards.example_en: Over the beach, a seagull stole a chip from our table.
cards.example_zh: 在海滩上空，一只海鸥从我们桌上叼走了一根薯条。

cards.example_en: I bought a secondhand bike from a neighbour for a low price.
cards.example_zh: 我以低价从邻居那里买了一辆二手自行车。

cards.example_en: You should sharpen your pencil before the drawing class at two.
cards.example_zh: 两点的绘画课之前，你应该把铅笔削尖。

cards.example_en: May I borrow your sharpener because mine is missing from my desk?
cards.example_zh: 我可以借你的卷笔刀吗？我的从桌上不见了。

cards.example_en: At that new stall the noodles were so-so, but the soup was good.
cards.example_zh: 在那家新摊，面条一般，不过汤很好喝。

cards.example_en: Guangzhou is in the southeast of China and is warm in winter.
cards.example_zh: 广州位于中国东南，冬天很暖和。

cards.example_en: Yunnan lies in the southwest and is famous for its mountains.
cards.example_zh: 云南位于西南，并以山脉闻名。

cards.example_en: Do not spit on the ground when you walk in the city.
cards.example_zh: 在城里走路时，不要随地吐痰。

cards.example_en: Wear strong shoes because the path up the hill is steep.
cards.example_zh: 要穿结实的鞋，因为上山的小路很陡。

cards.example_en: Her stocking had a hole after the long walk back home.
cards.example_zh: 走了很长的路回家后，她的长袜上有一个洞。

cards.example_en: Put on your sunglasses before we walk across the bright square.
cards.example_zh: 穿过明亮的广场之前，先戴上太阳镜。

cards.example_en: Morning sunlight filled the kitchen while we ate breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 我们吃早餐时，早晨的日光照进了厨房。

cards.example_en: We got up early to watch the sunrise from the hotel roof.
cards.example_zh: 我们早起，从酒店楼顶观看日出。

cards.example_en: Over the sea, the sunset turned the clouds orange and gold.
cards.example_zh: 在海上，日落把云朵染成了橙色和金色。

cards.example_en: Let's have lunch in the sunshine behind the school garden.
cards.example_zh: 咱们在学校花园后面的阳光下吃午饭吧。
